name: com.qq.e.comm.GDTFileProvider
description: The Tencent GDT (Youlianghui) ad SDK declares this provider for files in its configured folders and uses it to hand a local file to Android through a shareable content link. It is used during an ad download or file handoff.
disableEffect: GDT ad downloads or file handoffs may fail, while the app’s own screens remain available.
